informal_statement: Let \(A,B,C,D\) be Euclidean sets and \(f\) a function. If all six pairs are almost disjoint for \(\mathcal H^1\), \(B,C,D\) are measurable, and \(f\) is integrable on each of \(A,B,C,D\), then \[\int_{A\cup(B\cup(C\cup D))}f\,d\mathcal H^1=\int_Af\,d\mathcal H^1+\int_Bf\,d\mathcal H^1+\int_Cf\,d\mathcal H^1+\int_Df\,d\mathcal H^1.\]
